events.event: KPK says Rp800 million in cash handed over by Hercules Rosario de Marshal's lawyer allegedly came from PT Summarecon Agung to secure its Bogor land and to lift a land-office blockade, with ATR/BPN officials alleged to have been bribed.
events.key_numbers: Rp800 juta seized (KPK statement 15 Oct) · 8 suspects named (per article meta, details not read) · land in Bogor Regency
events.why_it_matters: A listed property developer and a well-known ormas figure appear in a land-bribery probe, which matters to Summarecon shareholders and to anyone buying land or housing.

events.event: ASDP ferry KMP Batumandi caught fire near Merak port; Basarnas says all passengers were evacuated safely and ASDP says it will cover passengers' losses.
events.key_numbers: 420 passengers · 89 vehicles (Polda Banten, per headline) · all passengers evacuated (Basarnas Banten) · evacuation to Dermaga 6 Eksekutif, Merak
events.why_it_matters: Merak-Bakauheni is the main Java-Sumatra crossing, so ferry safety affects millions of travellers and freight.

events.event: Bareskrim (Dittipidter) reveals a smuggling ring that sent baby lobster seeds from Pangandaran via Depok repacking to Vietnam, allegedly 40 times in about four months.
events.key_numbers: 73,000 seeds intercepted · ~3.5 juta seeds estimated overall at Rp80,000 each = Rp280 miliar (detik; another detik story cites Rp178 miliar) · 40 operations · 4 months · UU 31/2004 Pasal 92, >5 years, possible TPPU
events.why_it_matters: Indonesia's lobster seed wealth is being exported illegally, and the value gap shows why the ban/quota debate keeps returning.

events.event: BRIN's Thomas Djamaluddin says metal debris found in a palm plantation in Kotawaringin Timur, Central Kalimantan, is from China's ZhuQue-2E rocket.
events.key_numbers: Boom heard Sun 18 Oct · debris found Mon 19 Oct · BRIN statement Wed 21 Oct · second object found (dome-shaped, ~faded yellow, dimensions not given) · PT Agro Bukit plantation km 26
events.why_it_matters: Space junk landing near villages raises who is responsible and what Indonesians should do if they find it.
events.spreading_evidence: detik headline list; viral object photos (outlet-reported)

events.event: Police name 11 corporations as karhutla suspects, three of them foreign-owned, according to a Kompas headline.
events.key_numbers: 11 corporations · 3 foreign (headline only; article body blocked by robots)
events.why_it_matters: First time the haze story shifts from smoke to who gets charged, including foreign firms, as Singapore and Malaysia press Jakarta.
events.spreading_evidence: Kompas headline surfaced via search; not confirmed on a most-read list

events.event: BNPB reports progress on karhutla in six priority provinces while Central Kalimantan remains the worst; a further 60 ha burn in Palolo, Sigi (Central Sulawesi) and the Forestry Ministry calls for public participation.
events.key_numbers: 454.25 ha extinguished of 1,024.33 ha target (as of 19 Oct) · ~570.08 ha still being handled · Kalteng target 452.49 ha: 63.10 ha out, 389.39 ha not yet · outside-priority areas 572.90 ha · Palolo Sigi 60 ha · inversion layer 6,000-7,000 ft
events.why_it_matters: Only about 44% of the target area is out, so haze and flight disruption are likely to continue.

events.event: KPK widens the BNPB disaster-fund (DSP) case: it says the alleged corruption is tied to procurement for fires, floods, landslides and aid for displaced people, with 8 locations searched and documents, money and vehicles seized.
events.key_numbers: 8 locations searched · KPK statement 20 Oct 22:51 WIB · fund misuse probed since 2022 · earlier 5 suspects (14 Oct)
events.why_it_matters: Money meant for fire and flood response is under corruption investigation while the fires are still burning.

events.event: Pati Regent Sudewo (spelled Sudewa by ANTARA) is sentenced to 8.5 years in prison, per an ANTARA headline.
events.key_numbers: 8.5 years (headline only; fine and charges not read) · prosecutors had demanded 8.5 years and revocation of political rights (per search snippets)
events.why_it_matters: Another regional head jailed in a year with many KPK stings.

events.event: Central government sends five teams to look into the chilli price spike, while Transjakarta reroutes five routes around Balai Kota because of a protest.
events.key_numbers: 5 Kemendagri teams (19 Oct) · cabai merah keriting Rp126,400/kg on 19 Oct (+43.07%, per E0149) · 5 Transjakarta routes skip Balai Kota
events.why_it_matters: Chilli at over Rp120,000/kg hits every household kitchen and warung.

events.event: Liputan6 Cek Fakta compiles fake job-vacancy posts using Jasa Marga, Pertamina and Ombudsman names that lead to forms asking for full name as on KTP and a Telegram number.
events.key_numbers: Jasa Marga post on Instagram 17 Oct · Pertamina post on Facebook 29 Sep · Ombudsman post on Facebook 11 Aug · Jasa Marga says it recruits only via official site
events.why_it_matters: Job-seekers can lose personal data and money to fake recruiters.
events.spreading_evidence: Liputan6 Cek Fakta list (several hoax items 19 Oct)

events.event: Antara's Humaniora and terpopuler lists show MBG governance reform (BGN 'MBG 2.0') and Bulog-DPR food aid distribution covering three months' allocation.
events.key_numbers: Bantuan pangan allocation for 3 months (amount per household not read)
events.why_it_matters: Free meals and rice aid reach millions of families, and BGN is under pressure over poisoning cases.
events.spreading_evidence: ANTARA terpopuler (Bulog item); headline only for MBG 2.0
